description: External-facing API gateway that terminates TLS and applies rate limiting for all CrestPay payment traffic before forwarding to the payment orchestrator.
Coordinates the authorisation flow for card, instant transfer, and QR payments, including fraud checks, card switch calls, and ledger writes.
Primary transactional database recording the outcome of every payment processed through the payments platform.
Third-party card network switch used for external card authorisation. Hosted and operated by NorthGate, outside Crestline's infrastructure.
Backend API serving the CrestLine mobile banking app, including authentication, account overview, and transfers.
Switching infrastructure connecting Crestline ATM terminals nationwide to core banking for cash withdrawal and balance enquiry transactions.
System of record for customer accounts, balances, and ledger postings outside the dedicated payments ledger.
Internal event streaming platform used to propagate transaction state changes to downstream consumers such as notifications and reconciliation.
Synchronous fraud scoring service consulted by the payment orchestrator before authorising card, instant transfer, and QR transactions.
Web-based banking platform for account management, transfers, and bill payments, using a separate authentication path from mobile banking.
